title: knows a name from the read of one record and from the list
why: A record's name not kept as it is read: the quit's question cannot name a project the Library has listed.

title: knows a new project by the name it was made with, and a renamed one by its new name
why: A record's name not kept as it is written: a project renamed while it exports is asked about by its old name.

title: keeps the name it had when a write fails, and forgets a project that is deleted
why: A deleted project's name kept for as long as the app runs.
